definitions.explanation: A soft, watery dish made by cooking rice with extra water until it breaks down. Traditionally served to the sick, infants, and as a light meal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{粥|かゆ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: When I have a cold, I eat rice porridge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{離乳食|りにゅうしょく}→離乳食：14883_rinyuushoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{粥|かゆ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made rice porridge as baby food.

examples.japanese: ⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調子|ちょうし}→調子：03491_choushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{温|あたた}かい→温かい：13395_atatakai⟧お{粥|かゆ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My stomach isn't feeling well, so let's have warm rice porridge today.

notes:
USAGE:
The お prefix is standard and rarely dropped. A comfort food strongly associated with illness recovery and gentle eating. Also eaten for the ⟦{七草粥|ななくさがゆ}→七草粥：22751_nanakusagayu⟧ tradition on January 7th.

CULTURAL NOTE:
⟦{七草粥|ななくさがゆ}→七草粥：22751_nanakusagayu⟧ (seven-herb rice porridge) is eaten on January 7th to rest the stomach after New Year's feasting and to pray for good health.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{粥|かゆ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧ (to cook rice porridge)
- ⟦{七草粥|ななくさがゆ}→七草粥：22751_nanakusagayu⟧ (seven-herb rice porridge)
- {白粥|しらがゆ} (plain rice porridge)
